constraints: SCP-507 insists that it has no control over the time and duration of these shifts

evidence.locator: SCP-507 holds that during its periods of “disappearance” it is actually displaced into a random alternate reality; the landscape generally stays the same, but the inhabitants and climate of the parallel world often do not.

constraints: SCP-507 moves about in the alternate world

evidence.locator: If SCP-507 moves about in the alternate world, the eventual shift back will then place it at the corresponding area in our reality.

constraints: The agent was holding onto SCP-507's shoulder when it shifted

evidence.locator: When questioned, it said that ████ was holding onto its shoulder when it shifted, leading to both of them to appear in an alternate dimension where [EXPUNGED].
